context: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION The recommended dose of AUBAGIO is 7 mg or 14 mg orally once daily. AUBAGIO can be taken with or without food. 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS AUBAGIO is available as 7 mg and 14 mg tablets.
